input_messages.content:
Hi! I actually need help with a couple of things. I recently moved to a new house, but it’s still on Elm Avenue here in Houston. I noticed that one of my recent orders was sent to my old address instead of the new one. Can you help me update the shipping address for that order? Also, I’d like to make sure my default address is set to my new place so this doesn’t happen again. 

And one more thing—I’d like to exchange the tablet I ordered for the most affordable model you have, since I’m trying to save money after the move.

Sure! My name is Sophia Martin and my email is sophia.martin4832@example.com. Let me know if you need anything else to pull up my orders—I’d prefer not to share my address, but you should be able to see both my old and new addresses in my recent order history.

Thanks for pulling up my order! I’d really prefer not to share my new address directly—since I already placed an order for a luggage set to my new house on Elm Avenue, could you please use the address from that recent order as my new shipping and default address? That way, you’ll have the correct details without me needing to repeat them.

And yes, I only want to exchange the tablet from this order for the cheapest tablet you have. If there’s any price difference, you can use my Mastercard ending in 3292. Let me know what the options are!

Yes, that’s perfect! Please go ahead and:

1. Update the shipping address for my pending order to the address from my luggage set order.
2. Set that same address as my default address.
3. Exchange my current tablet for the 10-inch, 64GB, silver model at $903.95.
4. Use my Mastercard ending in 3292 for any price difference.

Thank you for handling all of this! Let me know if you need anything else from me.
Yes, please proceed with all of those changes. Thank you for confirming everything!

That’s great—thanks so much for your help! Everything sounds perfect now. Have a wonderful day! 

###STOP###
